title: dam path list answer
description: What dam path list prints with -o: every path that holds a task or event in scope, done ones included, and each of its parent paths, sorted by path. The root is not listed. Inside a project only the project's path and those under it are listed; a token counts only the objects it may read.

path.description: Written as dam prints an object's path, ending in /.

count.description: How many objects sit at or under the path.
